hwxNPIlYE0lMcqSs78p8eQ.zh: WHO於9/29報告全球去(2025)年累計47個國家報告45萬1,499例病例,其中7,870例死亡,總病例數較2024年下降,惟死亡人數較2024年增加30%,為1999年以來最高之單年死亡數,疫情集中於安哥拉、孟加拉、剛果⺠主共和國、奈及利亞、南蘇丹、蘇丹及葉門等7國(占全球病例數與死亡數約90%),且非洲病例數與死亡數皆上升。WHO於今年重啟預防接種計畫,並表示口服疫苗年產量已提升至8,000萬劑,惟逾1/5死亡病例發生於醫療機構之外,突顯延誤就醫問題嚴重性,呼籲各國應加速投資安全水質與衛生等設施。
hwxNPIlYE0lMcqSs78p8eQ.en: On 29 September, WHO reported that in 2025, 47 countries cumulatively reported 451,499 cases, including 7,870 deaths. Total cases were lower than in 2024, but deaths rose 30% over 2024, the highest annual death toll since 1999. Cases were concentrated in seven countries (Angola, Bangladesh, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Nigeria, South Sudan, Sudan and Yemen), which together accounted for about 90% of global cases and deaths; cases and deaths both rose in Africa. WHO restarted vaccination programmes this year and stated that annual oral vaccine production has risen to 80 million doses. However, more than one in five deaths occurred outside health facilities, highlighting the serious problem of delayed care-seeking, and WHO called on countries to accelerate investment in safe water and sanitation.

IZsSj8HZN75li16hnRULWA.zh: 葉門南部貝達地區(Al-Bayda)今年8月報告逾1,000例疑病例,其中6例死亡,媒體報導因水質受污染及監管不當導致疫情蔓延,且當地面臨快篩試劑與藥物短缺,推估疫情可能低估。
IZsSj8HZN75li16hnRULWA.en: In the Al-Bayda area of southern Yemen, more than 1,000 suspected cases and 6 deaths were reported in August this year. Media reports attribute the spread of the outbreak to water contamination and inadequate regulation. Local rapid test kits and medicines are in short supply, and the outbreak is likely underestimated.

gVEXCTZBRWgKeLrWnjw0XQ.zh: 葉門馬里卜(Marib)今年8/2宣布公共衛生緊急狀態(Public health emergency),今年截至8/2,累計報告1,624例病例,其中僅290例確定病例,及12例相關死亡案例。因當地診斷能力嚴重受限,疫情實際負擔比報告病例數要高得多。由於戰亂導致未接種疫苗等,當局已擴大疫苗接種,防止疫情擴散。 哈薩克北部庫斯塔奈(Kostanay)今年上半年累計報告167例確定病例,較去年同期10例,增加16倍,其中57例(34.1%)為未滿1 歲嬰兒。近期顯示疫情在北部多個地區蔓延,⺠眾疫苗猶豫現象造成免疫覆蓋率偏低,疫情持續傳播 。另該國於2024年報告27,967例病例,成為當年歐洲區域麻疹負擔最重之國家。 馬達加斯加瓦卡南卡拉特拉(Vakinankaratra),截至今年7月中旬,累計報告229例確定病例,2例於8/4-5期間死亡;該國42區中,有24區處於活躍期,18區為監測期。由於該國去年疫苗覆蓋率僅72%,以及學校假期,增加兒童跨區互動,加速疫情擴散。當局已在受影響地區進行補接種疫苗,並預計今年10月展開全國大規模疫苗接種。 美國疫情持續,今年截至8/9,累計報告2,465例確定病例(含16 例境外移入),高於去年2,289例。有68%為19歲以下兒童及青少年,93%為未接種疫苗或接種史不明者,7%病患住院治療,病例數以南卡羅萊納州(670例)及猶他州(524例)為多。另賓州近期疫情快速上升,8/10之當週新增57例確定病例,今年累計達232例。
gVEXCTZBRWgKeLrWnjw0XQ.en: Yemen: Marib declared a public health emergency on 2 August this year. As of 2 August, 1,624 cases had been reported cumulatively, of which only 290 were confirmed, along with 12 related deaths. Because local diagnostic capacity is severely limited, the true disease burden is much higher than the reported case count. Owing to armed conflict and low vaccination, authorities have expanded vaccination to prevent the outbreak from spreading. Kazakhstan: in Kostanay in the north, 167 confirmed cases were reported cumulatively in the first half of this year, compared with 10 in the same period last year, a 16-fold increase; 57 (34.1%) were infants under 1 year old. Recent data show the outbreak is spreading across several northern areas. Vaccine hesitancy among residents has led to low immunity coverage, and transmission continues. In addition, the country reported 27,967 cases in 2024, making it the country with the heaviest measles burden in the European Region that year. Madagascar: in Vakinankaratra, 229 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively as of mid-July this year, and 2 died between 4 and 5 August. Of the country's 42 districts, 24 are in the active phase and 18 are under surveillance. Because vaccination coverage last year was only 72%, and school holidays increased inter-district contact among children, the outbreak has accelerated. Authorities have carried out catch-up vaccination in affected areas and plan to launch nationwide mass vaccination in October this year. United States: the outbreak continues. As of 9 August this year, 2,465 confirmed cases (including 16 imported) have been reported cumulatively, higher than the 2,289 cases last year. 68% were children and young people aged 19 and under, 93% were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history, and 7% of patients were hospitalised. The largest numbers are in South Carolina (670) and Utah (524). In Pennsylvania, the outbreak has risen rapidly recently; 57 confirmed cases were added in the week of 10 August, bringing the total this year to 232.

FjZZYt2y_obXo1hdSlUAxQ.zh: 葉門塔伊茲省(Taiz)疫情上升,今年1至5月期間,累計逾400例人類病例,主要為兒童,迄無通報死亡病例。相較2024-2025年(分別為148、481例)疫情,顯著上升。當地疫苗與免疫球蛋白嚴重短缺,大幅限制暴露後預防(PEP)量能。 泰國羅勇府(Rayong)報告1件動物確定案例(該犬隻已死亡),3名遭咬傷⺠眾及具暴露風險之貓犬,皆已進行暴露後預防接種。當局已於羅勇府、曼谷及北欖府部分高風險地區發布臨時疫區公告,並實施為期30天的哺乳類動物移動限制。
FjZZYt2y_obXo1hdSlUAxQ.en: In Taiz Governorate, Yemen, cases are rising. From January to May this year, more than 400 human cases have been reported cumulatively, mainly among children, and no deaths have been reported so far. This is significantly higher than the cases reported in 2024 and 2025 (148 and 481 respectively). Local shortages of vaccines and immunoglobulin severely limit post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) capacity. In Rayong Province, Thailand, 1 confirmed animal case was reported (the dog has died). Three people who were bitten, and cats and dogs with exposure risk, have all received post-exposure vaccination. Authorities have issued temporary outbreak zone notices in high-risk areas of Rayong, Bangkok and Nonthaburi, and imposed a 30-day movement restriction on mammals.

_XEay6oXnBUZ8j19p1Q_tg.zh: 法屬馬約特島疫情上升,今年截至5月下旬累計報告197例病例,於5月份疫情傳播呈現加速趨勢,主要分布於南部地區(希龍吉),美國CDC近期提升法屬馬約特島疫情旅遊警示至第2級。 葉門塔伊茲省疫情上升,今年迄今累計報告逾22,000例病例,較往年明顯增加,該國約64%人口面臨感染風險,尤其是孕婦及5歲以下兒童為最脆弱族群。
_XEay6oXnBUZ8j19p1Q_tg.en: Malaria in Mayotte is rising: 197 cases had been reported cumulatively this year as of late May, and transmission accelerated in May, mainly in the southern region (Chirongui). The US CDC recently raised its travel alert for the Mayotte outbreak to Level 2. In Yemen's Taiz Governorate, malaria is rising: more than 22,000 cases have been reported so far this year, markedly higher than in previous years. About 64% of the country's population is at risk of infection, with pregnant women and children under 5 the most vulnerable.

zJlKmALp4sdLSbjrqo6fAg.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於5/14-20期間,cVDPV1新增南蘇丹1例;cVDPV2新增奈及利亞/葉門各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦1件,cVDPV2新增葉門2件。
zJlKmALp4sdLSbjrqo6fAg.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 14 and 20 May, cVDPV1 added one case in South Sudan, and cVDPV2 added one case each in Nigeria and Yemen. For environmental samples, WPV1 added one specimen in Pakistan and cVDPV2 added two in Yemen.

VkV-BraII9UK1d48LmYMGw.zh: 美國疫情持續,今年截至3/20共32州累計報告1,478例確定病例,其中74例住院,病患以5-19歲年齡層族群(781例)為多,主要分佈於南卡羅來納州(668例),其次為猶他州(275例)及德州(147例),近期疫情主要集中於猶他/德州,92%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明。 墨西哥疫情持續,今年截至3/20累計報告7,584例確定病例,其中8例死亡,病例數以西部哈利斯科州(4,439例)、南部恰帕斯州(650例)、中部墨西哥城(563例)為多。全國各州自去年迄今皆有報告病例,並以1-4歲兒童病例為多。 葉門疫情嚴峻,政府控制區於今年1月報告逾1,200例確定及8例死亡病例,另哈德拉毛沿海地區病例數急遽上升,該區疫苗接種率僅為7%,當局表示非政府控制區的疫情可能更加嚴重。估計該國去(2025)年累計逾2.3萬確定病例。
VkV-BraII9UK1d48LmYMGw.en: The United States outbreak continues: as of 20 March this year, 1,478 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 32 states, of which 74 were hospitalized. Patients are mainly aged 5–19 years (781 cases), and cases are concentrated in South Carolina (668 cases), followed by Utah (275 cases) and Texas (147 cases). Recent activity has been concentrated in Utah and Texas, and 92% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Mexico's outbreak continues: as of 20 March this year, 7,584 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, including 8 deaths. Cases are concentrated in western Jalisco State (4,439 cases), southern Chiapas State (650 cases) and Mexico City in the central region (563 cases). All states have reported cases since last year, mainly among children aged 1–4 years. Yemen's outbreak is severe: in government-controlled areas, more than 1,200 confirmed cases and 8 deaths were reported in January this year, and cases have risen sharply in the coastal area of Hadramawt, where vaccination coverage is only 7%. Authorities say the outbreak in areas not controlled by the government may be even more severe. The country is estimated to have reported more than 23,000 confirmed cases cumulatively last year.

e1E89mqT8TdsZE-fGTok4A.zh: 葉門2025年疫情明顯上升,共15省累計報告逾24,000例病例及67例死亡,且於亞丁及拉赫季省檢測出型別DENV-3及DENV-4。多種疾病共同流行,已為公共衛生嚴重挑戰。
e1E89mqT8TdsZE-fGTok4A.en: Dengue cases rose markedly in Yemen in 2025. A total of more than 24,000 cases and 67 deaths were reported across 15 governorates, and serotypes DENV-3 and DENV-4 were detected in Aden and Lahj governorates. Multiple diseases are circulating concurrently, which poses a serious public health challenge.

Afe9_Rviq5y1twRiHzmHSA.zh: 寮國沙灣拿吉省(Savannakhet)於12/12確診1例cVDPV1病例,為3歲個案,於9/3出現急性肢體無力症狀,並在其病毒檢體中發現31個基因突變點,推估已在該國傳播大約3年,另有2例相關病例檢測中;因本案鄰近越南邊界且往來密切,WHO評估越南面臨極高輸入及再出現病例風險,該國已召開全國緊急會議並加強監測。 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於12/4-10期間,cVDPV2新增3國共4例,分別為安哥拉2例、奈及利亞/葉門各1例;環境樣本部分,cVDPV2新增索馬利亞2件。
Afe9_Rviq5y1twRiHzmHSA.en: Savannakhet province in Laos confirmed one cVDPV1 case on 12 December, in a 3-year-old child who developed acute limb weakness on 3 September. The viral sample showed 31 genetic mutation sites, and the virus is estimated to have circulated in the country for about three years; two related cases are being tested. Because this case is near the Viet Nam border with close cross-border movement, WHO assesses that Viet Nam faces a very high risk of importation and re-emergence of cases. The country has convened a national emergency meeting and strengthened surveillance. The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for 4–10 December that cVDPV2 added 4 cases in 3 countries: 2 in Angola, and 1 each in Nigeria and Yemen. For environmental samples, cVDPV2 added 2 samples in Somalia.

UNHbWKTQg4Jp81s2zaylwg.zh: WHO公布全球今年截至10月累計報告逾56萬例病例,約7,000例死亡,其中,10月新增報告約3.5萬例,較9月下降34%,各國CFR介於0-8.2%;病例分布於東地中海、非洲、東南亞、美洲、西太平洋共32個國家/地區,近期新增病例以葉門、剛果民主共和國、安哥拉為多,目前口服疫苗庫存量高於緊急需求數。WHO評估約有10億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
UNHbWKTQg4Jp81s2zaylwg.en: The WHO reports that globally, as of October this year, more than 560,000 cases and about 7,000 deaths have been reported cumulatively. In October, about 35,000 new cases were reported, a 34% decrease from September, and national case fatality rates range from 0 to 8.2%. Cases have been distributed across 32 countries and areas in the Eastern Mediterranean, Africa, South-East Asia, the Americas and the Western Pacific. Recent new cases are concentrated in Yemen, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Angola. Current oral vaccine stocks exceed emergency demand. WHO estimates that about 1 billion people face the risk of infection, and the global transmission risk is very high.

0WUYgjfg2vWwD-SmBiU8CQ.zh: 葉門今年截至11/16報告380例確定病例,其中22例死亡,以南部阿比揚省63例為多,當局警告由於武裝控制區缺乏疫苗接種計畫,實際感染人數可能更高。
0WUYgjfg2vWwD-SmBiU8CQ.en: Yemen reported 380 confirmed cases this year as of 16 November, including 22 deaths. The southern governorate of Abyan had the most cases, with 63. Authorities warned that because there is no vaccination programme in areas under armed control, the actual number of infections may be higher.

__bwO64cavKvsD_IUBx22A.zh: 葉門北部胡希武裝控制地區10月報告5例死亡病例,皆為兒童,分別來自札馬爾省3名及沙那省2名,近期2例病患皆曾被流浪犬/貓抓咬傷,當地醫院缺乏暴露後預防藥物,致病患無法及時接受治療;札馬爾省每月發生逾400起狗咬人事件,當地媒體表示當局未採取相關防疫措施,致疫情加劇;該國2022年報告69例死亡病例。
__bwO64cavKvsD_IUBx22A.en: In the Houthi-controlled area of northern Yemen, five child deaths were reported in October, three from Dhamar governorate and two from Sana'a governorate. In the two most recent cases, the patients had been bitten or scratched by stray dogs or cats. The local hospital lacked post-exposure prophylaxis, so the patients could not receive timely treatment. Dhamar governorate records more than 400 dog-bite incidents a month, and local media say authorities have taken no relevant preventive measures, which has worsened the outbreak. Yemen reported 69 deaths in 2022.

ijG8mTyCHDhy1TRAA2bBfA.zh: WHO公布全球今年截至8月累計報告逾46萬例,近6,000例死亡,其中,8月新增報告逾5.7萬例,較7月下降16%,各國CFR介於0-9.8%;病例分布於非洲、東地中海、東南亞、美洲、西太平洋共32個國家/地區,以阿富汗、南蘇丹及葉門為多;WHO評估約有10億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
ijG8mTyCHDhy1TRAA2bBfA.en: WHO reports that globally, as of August this year, more than 460,000 cases and nearly 6,000 deaths have been reported cumulatively. In August, more than 57,000 new cases were reported, 16% lower than in July, with national case fatality rates ranging from 0 to 9.8%. Cases have been distributed across 32 countries and areas in Africa, the Eastern Mediterranean, South-East Asia, the Americas and the Western Pacific, mainly in Afghanistan, South Sudan and Yemen. WHO assesses that about one billion people face the risk of infection, and the global transmission risk is very high.

te-55ufcQ2ClxQUbcfUTeA.zh: WHO公布全球今年截至7月累計報告約38萬例,4,478例死亡,其中,7月新增報告約6.8萬例、死亡624例,較6月上升14%,各國CFR介於0-11.2%;病例分布於非洲、東地中海、東南亞及美洲共31個國家/地區,以南蘇丹、阿富汗、葉門及剛果民主共和國為多;WHO評估約有10億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
te-55ufcQ2ClxQUbcfUTeA.en: WHO reports that globally, as of July this year, about 380,000 cases and 4,478 deaths have been cumulatively reported. In July alone, about 68,000 new cases and 624 deaths were reported, a 14% increase over June. Case fatality rates across countries range from 0–11.2%. Cases are distributed across 31 countries and regions in Africa, the Eastern Mediterranean, South-East Asia and the Americas, with the most in South Sudan, Afghanistan, Yemen and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. WHO estimates that about one billion people are at risk of infection, and assesses the global transmission risk as very high.

dSjEaxSkzroRgkZ0V0v8Ew.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於8/14-20期間,WPV1新增巴基斯坦2例;cVDPV1新增剛果民主共和國1例;cVDPV2新增3國共28例,分別為葉門26例、安哥拉/中非共和國各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦42件,cVDPV2新增坦尚亞1件。
dSjEaxSkzroRgkZ0V0v8Ew.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 14–20 August, WPV1 increased by two cases in Pakistan, and circulating vaccine-derived poliovirus type 1 (cVDPV1) increased by one case in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. cVDPV2 increased by 28 cases in three countries: Yemen (26), and Angola and the Central African Republic (1 each). For environmental samples, WPV1 increased by 42 samples in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 by one sample in Tanzania.

iaXTQHwiU1simsh9d3yy6A.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於8/7-13期間,WPV1新增巴基斯坦1例;cVDPV2新增3國共53例,分別為葉門46例、衣索比亞6例、奈及利亞1例;環境樣本部分,cVDPV1新增以色列3件。
iaXTQHwiU1simsh9d3yy6A.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 7–13 August, WPV1 increased by one case in Pakistan. cVDPV2 increased by 53 cases in three countries: Yemen (46), Ethiopia (6) and Nigeria (1). For environmental samples, cVDPV1 increased by three samples in Israel.

G1T9nxgMOeFe6jlpmjQnLg.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於7/17-30期間,WPV1新增巴基斯坦3例;cVDPV2新增3國共49例,分別為葉門43例、奈及利亞5例、衣索比亞1例;環境樣本部分,cVDPV2新增2國共7件,分別為巴布亞紐幾內亞6件、象牙海岸1件。
G1T9nxgMOeFe6jlpmjQnLg.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 17–30 July, WPV1 increased by three cases in Pakistan. cVDPV2 increased by 49 cases in three countries: Yemen (43), Nigeria (5) and Ethiopia (1). For environmental samples, cVDPV2 increased by seven samples in two countries: Papua New Guinea (6) and Côte d'Ivoire (1).

7SH3zz-BkfFeKNDMsecHrA.zh: 墨西哥今年迄今報告逾7,000例疑病例,其中超過3,900例確診及14例死亡,病例數以北部契瓦瓦州逾3,600例為多,且以0-4歲嬰幼兒為主,惟實際病例數可能更高,該國目前疫苗覆蓋率僅76%,當局已啟動監測及接種疫苗計畫。 剛果民主共和國東部南基伍省今年迄今報告4,057例,其中122例死亡(CFR:3%),由於當地交通不便及局勢不穩定,死亡率偏高,當局已規劃疫苗接種計畫。 葉門今年截至7/14累計報告2萬餘例疑病例及178例死亡(CFR: 0.85%),病例集中於西部荷台達省及札馬爾省。
7SH3zz-BkfFeKNDMsecHrA.en: Mexico has reported more than 7,000 suspected cases this year, of which more than 3,900 are confirmed, and 14 deaths. Cases are highest in northern Chihuahua State, with more than 3,600, and are mainly among infants and young children aged 0–4. Actual case numbers may be higher. Mexico's vaccination coverage is only 76%, and authorities have launched a surveillance and vaccination programme. In eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, South Kivu Province has reported 4,057 cases this year, of which 122 died (CFR: 3%). The high mortality is attributed to poor transport and instability in the area, and authorities have planned a vaccination programme. Yemen has reported more than 20,000 suspected cases and 178 deaths cumulatively as of 14 July this year (CFR: 0.85%). Cases are concentrated in Hudaydah and Dhamar governorates in the west.

JJ420vWXagCIspeEq_2CuA.en: WHO reports that as of June this year, nearly 306,000 cases and 3,522 deaths have been reported globally. In June alone, about 62,000 new cases and 527 deaths were reported, a 21% decrease from May. Case fatality ratios range from 0 to 8.1% across countries. Cases were distributed across 28 countries and territories in Africa, the Eastern Mediterranean and South-East Asia, with the most in South Sudan, Yemen, Afghanistan and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The global emergency stockpile of oral cholera vaccine currently stands at 2.9 million doses, below the safe threshold of 5 million doses. An estimated 1 billion people face a risk of infection, and WHO assesses the global transmission risk as very high.
